title: Reduce Completed UI helper exports
summary: Removed two transitional flat window.* aliases for Completed UI helper functions after moving the remaining app and command-history consumers to window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup in a scoped Completed UI helper slice while preserving intentional flat compatibility hooks still used by Pending Publish, row selection, and browser smokes.
behavior_before: The Completed clear-filters button handler called resetCompletedFilters through a direct global name, command-history refresh called renderCompletedOutputAcceptance through a direct global name, and completedView.js exported both helpers as flat window.* aliases in addition to the Completed namespace.
behavior_after: The Completed clear-filters button handler and command-history refresh read those helpers through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView, and completedView.js keeps resetCompletedFilters and renderCompletedOutputAcceptance namespace-only. Other existing Completed flat aliases are unchanged.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py to require namespace access for resetCompletedFilters and renderCompletedOutputAcceptance and to assert the served Completed source no longer assigns those flat aliases.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api.LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype -q (baseline passed before edit; passed after edit)

.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.WebViewBrowserCompletedPendingProofSmoke.test_real_browser_renders_completed_pending_proof_overlap_and_missing_output_detail -q (baseline passed before edit; passed after edit)
.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_row_detail_smoke -q (baseline passed before edit; passed after edit)
rg -n "window\.(resetCompletedFilters|renderCompletedOutputAcceptance)\b" apps tests docs --glob '!docs/generated/summaries/**' (only negative assertions remain)
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore the two direct Completed UI helper window.* aliases, move app.js and commandHistory.js consumers back to the direct global helper names, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the prior flat export counts in docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.
